title: Panther Masquerade
style: Phonk with sneaky half-time bounce, dusty log-drum pulses, marimba stabs, shakers, handclaps, beatboxed kicks, and choir-like backing singers woven as living instruments; verse glides low and playful, pre-chorus tightens with filtered chants, chorus opens with stacked harmonies and gang replies, bridge drops to beatbox and call-response, final chorus adds bright percussion lifts and playful ad-libs. Close-mic lead vocal, dry and cheeky in verses, wide harmonized hook, crisp punchy mix with earthy low end and shiny ear candy., comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I came with my grin on, sly like a cat
Kente on my shoulder, I’m sliding like that
Mama at the market say, “boy, behave”
I said, “I’m just dancing with the palm wine wave”

Beatbox boots, make the floor say “tuk”
Clay pot talk when I step with the hook
Two aunties laugh when I flick that wrist
Say my small waist got a whole town twist

[Pre-Chorus]
Mm, hold that step
Don’t rush, don’t trip
I hear the drum in the ribs
I hear the crowd go flip

Mm, one more grin
One more spin
When the harmonies roll in
We all do it again

[Chorus]
Panther on the loose (hey)
Panther on the loose (ay)
Sneak through the room
Then boom, boom, boom

Panther on the loose (hey)
Panther on the loose (ay)
Move with the crew
And the whole place moves

[Verse 2]
I brought my people and the melody too
One voice for the front, one voice for the groove
One voice says “chai,” one says “olé”
Every little echo got a job to play

Shakers go quick like a secret plan
Log drum talking like a wise old man
Palm tap, heel tap, coat too neat
Even the bassline got village feet

[Pre-Chorus]
Mm, see us shine
Side by side
Lead sings out, then the rest reply
Like a train in the night

Mm, feel that grin
Feel that pride
When the chorus comes alive
We don’t need to hide

[Chorus]
Panther on the loose (hey)
Panther on the loose (ay)
Sneak through the room
Then boom, boom, boom

Panther on the loose (hey)
Panther on the loose (ay)
Move with the crew
And the whole place moves

[Bridge]
[Beatbox Break]
Buh-tsk, buh-tsk, pah-pah
Buh-tsk, buh-tsk, pah-pah

Small joke, big smile
Big feet, short mile
Call me “where you from?”
I say, “everywhere, my child”

[Chorus]
Panther on the loose (hey)
Panther on the loose (ay)
Sneak through the room
Then boom, boom, boom

Panther on the loose (hey)
Panther on the loose (ay)
Move with the crew
And the whole place moves

[Outro]
Ay, ay, ay
We laugh, we sway
Oye, oye, say
We dance that way
